answer: The inlet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tide. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The velvet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
